Your Habits note now has a habit tracker. Open the note and switch to **Page** to use it.

**Your log is now a table.** I moved your week of entries (28 Sep – 4 Oct) into a table in the note. It has a Date column, one column each for Walk, Read, Stretch and No phone in bed, and a Note column that keeps "too tired" and "party." I then removed the old written log lines so you don't have the same days written twice. You can get them back from the note's history if you want them.

**What the page does:**
- **Tick off habits:** each habit is a big button you can tap on your phone. There's a Today / Yesterday switch in case you forget to log one night. Each tick adds a ✓ to the table.
- **Streaks:** each habit shows how many days in a row you've done it and your best run so far. Right now Read and Stretch are at 2 days and No phone in bed is at 1.
- **This week:** a progress bar for each habit. You can type in a weekly goal (days per week) if you want to aim for one.
- **Last 14 days:** a grid showing which days each habit was done.

You can still edit the table directly in the note's text if you prefer.
